en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town with open fields in the foreground. On a hill behind the town sits a large medieval castle complex with several towers. To the left of the castle is a tall church with a slender spire rising above the clustered town houses. Trees frame the scene at the bottom and right edges. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Stolpen i. Sa."
